title: Lost Mary Maryliq Peach Ice 10ml Nic Salt E-Liquid
description: Discover Maryliq: Lost Mary's iconic flavours as found in bestselling disposable vapes like the BM600, QM600 and AM600, are now available in 10ml nicotine salt e-liquids. Maryliq provides a discreet, yet richly flavoured vapour and a smooth throat hit, offering quick relief for your nicotine cravings. Available in 10mg & 20mg strengths, it's the ideal choice for recent quitters or those after immediate nicotine satisfaction. Unlike traditional high-PG freebase liquids, Maryliq's nic salts deliver a smoother throat hit and quicker nicotine absorption. Compatible with starter and pod vape kits, these 10ml bottles let you enjoy your favourite flavours longer than 2ml disposables, minimising plastic waste. Experience all-day vaping satisfaction and flavour with Maryliq Nic Salts. Refresh your senses with the succulent flavour of ripe Peaches elevated by a cool icy blast in Lost Mary Maryliq's Peach Ice. This e-liquid brings the natural sweetness of Peach to the forefront, accompanied by an invigorating icy kick that offers a satisfying chill. It's like biting into a fresh, juicy Peach on a hot summer's day—except you can experience this sensation anytime you want. With a balanced 50% VG / 50% PG blend, this e-liquid provides a smooth throat hit and bountiful cloud production, making it perfect for those who enjoy a revitalising, flavourful vape.
